業務ソフト・データの提携先

relations.text: UiPathとOpenAIが、ChatGPTコネクターを作る協業を発表した
relations.text_en: UiPath announced a collaboration with OpenAI to build a ChatGPT connector for enterprise workflows

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: UiPath announced a collaboration with OpenAI to build a ChatGPT connector that integrates OpenAI frontier models with enterprise customer workflows, powered by UiPath enterprise orchestration, accelerating time to value and ROI from their agentic AI efforts.

relations.text: UiPathが、Anthropicの大規模言語モデルClaude 3.5 Sonnetを3つの主要製品に組み込むと発表した
relations.text_en: UiPath announced the integration of Anthropic's large language model, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, in three key products

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: UiPath announced the integration of Anthropic’s large language model (LLM), Claude 3.5 Sonnet, to deliver new AI features in three key products, including UiPath Autopilot for Everyone, Clipboard AI, and a new medical record summarization solution.

relations.text: UiPathが、Microsoft Azure AI Foundryとの統合を発表した
relations.text_en: UiPath announced an integration with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: UiPath announced an integration with Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, enabling customers to automate end-to-end processes using UiPath agents interacting with Azure AI Foundry agents and models.

relations.text: AI Innovation HubをMicrosoftなどと提携して運営している
relations.text_en: UiPath's AI Innovation Hub is run in partnership with global technology leaders such as Microsoft

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: The AI Innovation Hub serves as a collaborative space to drive the latest in AI research, development, and business solutions in partnership with University College London and global technology leaders such as Microsoft, SAP, and AWS.

relations.text: UiPath IXPがGoogle Cloud Marketplaceで利用可能になり、新規IXPプロジェクトの既定の外部モデルにGeminiが採用される
relations.text_en: UiPath IXP is now available on Google Cloud Marketplace, and Gemini will become the default third-party model for new IXP projects

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: UiPath announced that UiPath Intelligent Xtraction and Processing (IXP) is now available on Google Cloud Marketplace and that Gemini will become the default third-party model for new IXP projects, enabling customers to process longer, more complex documents with greater speed and accuracy.

relations.text: Gemini搭載のAI文書処理ソリューションをGoogle Cloud Marketplaceで提供開始した
relations.text_en: UiPath announced availability of its AI Document Processing Solution on Google Cloud Marketplace with Gemini-powered automation

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announced Availability of AI Document Processing Solution in Google Cloud Marketplace with Gemini-Powered Automation:

relations.text: AI Innovation HubをAWSなどと提携して運営している
relations.text_en: UiPath's AI Innovation Hub is run in partnership with global technology leaders such as AWS

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: The AI Innovation Hub serves as a collaborative space to drive the latest in AI research, development, and business solutions in partnership with University College London and global technology leaders such as Microsoft, SAP, and AWS.
source.note: AWSとの個別の契約内容は引用からは分かりません。
source.note_en: The quote does not describe a separate AWS agreement.

relations.text: UiPathとNVIDIAが、不正検知などの高い信頼性が必要な場面でAI機能を強化する協業を発表した
relations.text_en: UiPath announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to add AI capabilities to automated workflows in high-trust scenarios such as fraud detection

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: UiPath announced a collaboration with NVIDIA to help enterprise customers fortify their existing automated workflows with AI capabilities in high-trust scenarios, such as fraud detection or care management in healthcare.

relations.text: Inflectionとの協業を通じ、UiPathをIntelのTiber AI Cloudの選択肢にする計画がある
relations.text_en: Through its collaboration with Intel, Inflection intends to make UiPath available as an option on Intel's Tiber AI Cloud

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: Through its collaboration with Intel, Inflection intends to make UiPath available as an option to Intel’s Tiber AI Cloud service, leveraging Intel’s new Gaudi 3 processors.

relations.text: UiPathが、SAP顧客向けの企業オートメーション統合サービスを発表した
relations.text_en: UiPath announced an integrated offering with SAP to accelerate enterprise automation for SAP customers

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • Announces an Integrated Offering with SAP to Accelerate Enterprise Automation for SAP Customers:

relations.text: UiPathが、SalesforceのAgentExchangeでUiPath CX CompanionとUiPath Maestro Connectorを公開した
relations.text_en: UiPath launched UiPath CX Companion and UiPath Maestro Connector on Salesforce's AgentExchange

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: UiPath launched UiPath CX Companion and UiPath Maestro Connector on AgentExchange, Salesforce’s marketplace for the agentic era that brings together the rich ecosystem of AppExchange, Slack, and Agentforce into one experience.

relations.text_en: UiPath joined the Veeva AI Partner Program to enable agentic testing in life sciences

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: • UiPath Joined Veeva AI Partner Program to Enable Agentic Testing in Life Sciences:

relations.text: UiPathが、UiPath PlatformとSnowflake Cortex AIを組み合わせるパートナーシップを発表した
relations.text_en: UiPath announced a partnership with Snowflake, uniting the UiPath Platform with Snowflake Cortex AI

source.label: UiPath 8-K Ex.99 の発表
source.quote: UiPath announced a partnership with Snowflake, uniting the UiPath Platform™ for agentic automation with Snowflake Cortex AI, empowering businesses to quickly turn data insights into faster and smarter autonomous actions.
